temporal_methods.label: Schedule-Aligned Traversal (+5m Base)
temporal_methods.description: Maps hourly OD volume onto active GTFS scheduled trips along the unique physical path. Klang Valley AFC tap-out timestamps align primarily via latest arrival within 90m before exit tap (+ bounded 90m forward fallback). Komuter Utara KITS timestamps adopt symmetric 50/50 bounded mixed matching (50% arrival-aligned within 120m w/ 120m forward fallback + 50% forward departure-aligned within 120m, +5m buffer), preventing unbounded overnight/2h-gap pooling while exposing forward, arrival, transaction-hour, and KITS anomaly-excluded scenario ranges.

temporal_methods.label: Tight Schedule Sensitivity (0m Buffer)
temporal_methods.description: Zero-minute boarding buffer sensitivity testing boundary-minute sensitivity under the identical matching framework.

temporal_methods.label: Transaction-Hour Baseline (Diagnostic)
temporal_methods.description: Projects raw OD volume instantaneously along all path segments in the transaction clock hour without timetable train concentration.

capacity_modes.label: Official 2023 Rate Card Nominal (1,118 KV / 400 Utara)
capacity_modes.description: KTMB ETS-REDCARD (2023) total seated + standing nominal capacity per scheduled trainset.

capacity_modes.label: 80% Planning Comfort Sensitivity (894 KV / 320 Utara)
capacity_modes.description: Derived 80% load comfort sensitivity benchmark; never presented as physical measurement or official regulation.

formulas.scheduled_capacity: S = N * C (scheduled segment train crossings N in clock hour * nominal train capacity C)
formulas.load_ratio_pct: Load Ratio (%) = (D / S) * 100 when S > 0; null when S == 0 (never zero-divided)
formulas.additional_trains_needed: Extra Trains = ceil(Deficit / C) == max(0, ceil(D / C) - N) per individual segment-hour (never summed across adjacent segments)
formulas.station_conservation: D_in - A + B == D_out; Remaining = max(0, S_out - T); Boarding Gap = max(0, B - Remaining); Upstream Full Flag = (T > S_out)

stat_aggregations.mean: Ratio of slice-mean hourly demand divided by slice-mean hourly scheduled capacity at the peak mean hour across verified dates in the slice.
stat_aggregations.p90: Coherent 90th-percentile daily-peak representative observation (nearest-rank P90 across verified operating dates), pulling exact matching date, hour, demand, scheduled trains, capacity, and upstream through-load.
stat_aggregations.max_date: Single highest observed verified date-hour overload within the selected slice, with matching same-date 24h scheduled capacity (never blended mean schedules).
